notes.title: 1.17.0: Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p align="start"]This patch adds more preparation for the upcoming [i]Boys in Hawaii! [/i]expansion, featuring several touchscreen-specific updates to improve the experience when playing on a touch device.[/p][p align="start"]Kemopop! will get a ceremonial bump to 2.0 with the release of [i]Boys in Hawaii![/i]. This will signify a milestone and the release of a major new feature. A small sample of it has been snuck into this patch...![/p][p]Someone pointed out the Workshop wasn't fully set up; this was fixed last night. You'll see more visibility about it now.[/p][list][*][p]\[Gameplay] The Hotshot bonus now applies a multiplier to the special charge meter.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Gameplay] Dropping hazards that cannot make a match (e.g. tar) will not reset the Hotshot combo.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Gameplay] The tar ratio on Sencha's stage has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] Updated the Hotshot score effect.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] When playing with the mouse, the cursor will change to a weaker crosshair to signify pieces cannot be dropped.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] Improved the fidelity of the sphere backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] Removed the old Golden Gate bridge background from the Photo Mode, as it is not used anywhere anymore. Geomecs's redraw of this background is now in the Gumball Machine!!![/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] Removed the first run setup screen.[/p][list][*][p]Touch controls will be enabled automatically if Android is detected.[/p][list][*][p]Players not enabling this on Android would suffer, so it's best they have it on until they are in a position to figure out how to turn it off, if they absolutely need to.[/p][/*][*][p]Most PC players probably did not immediately need to see this option.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Display language is inferred from the system locale and can still be changed through the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty can still be changed through the settings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]\[UI] Increased the size of the scrollbar, making it easier to grab on a touch device.[/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] The title screen now has a button prompt, rather than "press any button", as pressing any button could just close the game.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Touch] Button prompts are now hidden when Touch Mode is enabled, to reduce unnecessary clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Touch] Hidden touch controls on more scenes where explicit controls aren't necessary.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Touch] The directional arrows on the touch interface (seen in photo mode) are now correctly anchored to the bottom left corner.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Touch] Touch interface controls will give feedback to indicate a button is pressed.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Touch] Touch interface controls will no longer grab focus.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Touch] Interacting with the touch controls will no longer move the position of the sweet launcher during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] Addressed several instances where inputs on the touch interface would frequently not register.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] The directional arrows on the touch interface were not reactive.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] Improved the display of several elements on wide aspect ratios, including the settings and biography overlays.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] Improve navigation on the character select screen. Navigation would be unpredictable in certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] Biographies would not display on a non-Steam version of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] Unwarranted extra typing audio in the ending cutscene, and the volume has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Fix] Crash when creating Demo-tan.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.16.3: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello!! This patch contains some fixes and improvements while development on Boys in Hawaii! is underway.

[list]
[*] [b]Steam Workshop:[/b] Failed initial content uploads will now delete the created workshop entry (rather than leaving a broken workshop upload).
[*] [b]Steam Workshop:[/b] Added a check to make sure you've at least tried to edit the template, to prevent people just uploading Demo-tan.
[*] Updated the supporter list.
[*] Fix: A nasty performance and implementation bug with the Hotshot combo that would cause combos to never properly record, and the game to slow down.
[*] Fix: Reinstate the tooltips on the alt stage icons, since they contained important unlock info.
[*] Fix: A rare issue where the screen would be stuck in a transition if typing/pressing too fast at the splash screen.
[/list]

notes.title: The Anniversary Update!
notes.notes: [p]It has been roughly one year since Kemopop! was published to Steam. Ergo, this is the Anniversary Update!! Keep scrolling for news on the first expansion :3![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam Workshop (Beta)[/b][/h3][p]On Steam, this update has added Steam Workshop support. I'd love to see your characters, so please try this out...! To publish a character, open the Biography page of your custom character and click [b]Publish[/b]. You can update your character at any time.[/p][p](While keys last, Steam keys can still be claimed through itch.io purchases.)[/p][list][*][p]Custom character handling has been improved, and will no longer hang the game during the load transition.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Workshop Troubleshooting[/b][/p][p]This feature is quite barebones and investigation is needed. If you have issues with Workshop integration, please make the issue known on the Steam discussion boards.[/p][p][/p][p]It is recommended you resize your character icon.png to ~500x500 to alleviate issues with file size limits. Everything else should be okay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam Trading Cards are now available![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107150/c543264b68087d68c064cff671aeeeef0e209544.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Trading Cards and an array of :kemo_speaking_left:emoticons:kemo_speaking_right: and wallpapers are now available for the Steam release. If you ever wanted to put a half-naked goat boy on your Steam profile as a flex, now you can. Just collect all ten cards in the Kemopop! trading card set!![/p][p]The trading cards have been designed in collaboration with [url="http://twitter.com/wofychuu"]Wofy Yems[/url], a Malaysian artist.[/p][p](Later, these items will be available to purchase using Steam Points).[/p][p][url="https://t.me/addstickers/Kemopop"]Download the Telegram stickerpack[/url]!!![/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Visual Refresh![/b][/h3][p]Azura is the first character players are introduced to when playing Kemopop!. Azura's stage art has been relined and given an extra hour of polish, to bring it up to standard with some later added characters.[/p][p]Everywhere else, more attention has been put into the game's visuals and controller UX.[/p][list][*][p]Baro's stage art has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Character selection has been given a new appearance. [/p][list][*][p][b]Compact Menu [/b]is a new display setting that will collapse the menu groups.[/p][/*][*][p]The new particle effects behind the character overview card now have slight hints about the stage's content...!!![/p][/*][*][p]Menu navigation has been altered a bit to allow better browsing of characters. Selecting a stage won't move the focus to the play button, but a new shortcut key has been added to immediately play a selected stage.[/p][/*][*][p]The biography button was moved somewhere more appropriate (from playtesting, some players didn't even acknowledge it).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Several new animations and particle effects have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The game logo has been redesigned slightly to improve legibility against busy backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The Photo Mode UI has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Stages without a clear line (e.g. suika) will now show refill quotes on level ups, revealing some unused content.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Get a Hotshot Combo!![/b][/h3][p]A new scoring subsystem has been introduced into the anniversary update. In a nutshell, this is how it works:[/p][list][*][p]Dropping a sweet and touching one of the same kind will maintain the combo (you'll hear a quiet 'tick' sound and see a little hit marker).[/p][list][*][p]There is a little leeway! It's possible to bounce off another sweet and maintain the combo, but it'll have to be quick...[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If there is a match, the combo increases.[/p][/*][*][p]You may miss one time in between combo increments. If you miss twice, the combo is reset to zero.[/p][/*][/list][p]The rationale behind this change is twofold: it encourages an alternative, slow and calculated kind of play, and rewards new players who tend to play carefully.  It's tougher to maintain, but the point scores from a high hotshot combo are higher!!![/p][list][*][p]Two new achievements have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The scoring system has been adjusted to encourage use of the hotshot system.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The game engine has been updated (Godot 4.3 -> Godot 4.4).[/p][/*][*][p]An older background seen on Mio's stage has been replaced with a pixel art rendition by [url="http://twitter.com/geomecs"]Geomecs[/url]!![/p][/*][*][p]New refill quotes have been added across several stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Refill quotes are no longer entirely random and will increase in horniness depending on the stage level.[/p][/*][*][p]Some items on the Gumball Machine now require certain achievements to be completed. Fanart unlocks will often require a stage to be completed, but these requirements are generally hidden.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Vault[/b]: A new Guestbook page has been added. Unlocking this will bring back an old stage (Requires beating the campaign).[/p][/*][*][p]The localisation files have been updated, mostly for Korean (thank you, Commander_P).[/p][/*][*][p]A new mouse cursor style has been added for gameplay purposes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Credits have been updated.[/p][list][*][p]Individual sections can now be skipped by interacting with the primary input.[/p][/*][*][p]The supporters credits have been updated to reflect recent supporters![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fix: There is now a minimum window size of 800x450.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Adjusted the click boundary for navigating out of the Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: An issue where the screen transition might get stuck on white if moving through scenes too fast has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Merch!![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107150/ea92a9736c06b5a3f36f02c81151a6966f60014f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Head over to [url="https://lemoncre.me/products/m-kappu-3d-bulge-mouse-pad"]lemoncre.me[/url] to grab Kappu's bulge (mousepad)!! There's some other stickers of mine there, too...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]One More Thing~!!![/b][/h3][p]We are now ready to share information on the first expansion to the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107150/a4933b1b707b622e09ace9dafa48b11d92250521.png"][/img][/p][p]More than just a character pack, [i]Boys in Hawaii![/i] is an expansion building onto Kemopop! with new stages, characters, and features. More information on [i]Boys in Hawaii![/i] will be available soon![/p][p]----[/p][p]If you are interested in furthering the development of Kemopop! and other projects, [url="https://subscribestar.adult/fisuku"]consider joining my SubscribeStar[/url]...! You get to join a Discord server of likeminded people!!! [/p][p]:kemo_cake:[/p]

notes.title: 1.14.12: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
I am currently in my hotel room for NordicFuzzCon!! There is a tiny issue I needed a Steam Deck and an external controller to fix. Conveniently, my friends had both.

[list]
[*] The first-time setup screen has been updated.
[*] Certain interfaces have had their text sizes increased for improved Steam Deck legibility.
[*] Fix: Controller navigation on a Steam Deck using an external controller will now work properly.
[/list]
I am going back to the convention now.

notes.title: 1.14.9: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This is mostly an update to improve Steam Deck support, as a final final final final step before we leave Early Access!!!! @w@
[list]
[*] An official set of Steam Deck controller bindings has been added. This includes a Trackpad scheme; mastering this should provide more accurate aiming.
[*] Input glyphs now have a contextual border.
[*] Tutorial messages mentioning inputs are now aware of the current input scheme.
[*] Fix: Joypad input glyphs will always be displayed on the Steam Deck, even if the touchscreen or cursor is used.
[*] Fix: Left joystick navigation should now work as expected on all controllers.
[/list]
In other news, I am pleased to announce that we are finally eligible for Steam Economy items and Trading Cards!!! I was not expecting this news, and I will be spending a while drawing these materials, so don't expect anything in this regard for a little bit. Rest assured, this is on its way.

notes.title: 1.14.3: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello!!

[list]
[*] Brock's stage artwork has been updated.
[*] A "none" Special Weapon has been added (currently, just for custom stages).
[*] Balance: The Special Gain% of Rainbow Sweets has been reduced by half.
[*] Balance: Cake's second stage has been made slightly easier.
[*] Fix: Made sure the Stopwatch and Overflow Warning obey the SFX volume setting.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.13.5: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
(These are belated patch notes that I somehow didn’t publish!!! Also, a Steam achievement for the new stage is currently missing. This will be added later today and will be granted when launching the game if you already achieved it.)

I promised an update before the end of 2024. I have been travelling a lot, so I haven't been able to do much... @w@;

[url=https://x.com/Luminous_Wish]Luminous_Wish[/url] has provided a new guest stage. Hello Lyn!! (This stage has been playtested; it is difficult, but possible to clear on Legend difficulty!)

[list]
[*] Several new fanarts from [url=https://x.com/popkage]Sakuroke[/url] have been added to the gumball machine (there was also a previously missing one...)!!
[*] To ease introduction into the game, Azura's stages have been made easier to complete with lowered stage level goals.
[*] In the Guestbook, buttons have been added to link to artist portfolios to better promote fanart contributions.
[*] Some elements have been adjusted to increase overall text size.
[/list]

Full release has been pushed back a bit. At least two new stages are pending addition.

Happy New Year! あけましておめでとう！

notes.title: 1.13.4: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
No new stages this week, but some technical polishing!!

[list]
[*] A new unlockable music track has been added.
[*] New fanart has been added to the Guestbook! A previous page was split into two for consistency reasons.
[*] The animation of gacha capsules has been improved.
[*] Sweet textures have been optimised; idle texture memory here has been reduced by 66%, over 100MB!! (We'll fill this space with more sweets...!)
[*] The button indicator font size has been increased, and reacts to button presses.
[*] Improved the display of tooltips for other languages.
[*] 日本語： 新しいロゴ
[*] 한국인: The Korean localisation has been updated (thank you Kero/大神!!).
[*] Fix: Hitboxes on the Gumball Machine have been updated to prevent capsules from leaking out at the top.
[/list]
Additionally, we are seeking Steam Deck Verified status, so we are awaiting a further review.

notes.title: 1.13.2: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello!! A small patch to clean up the most recent major update!!

[list]
[*] Time Attack now has variable start time + refill time based on the current difficulty level setting.
[*] The game now saves at an extra point, so you should no longer see character unlock notifications a second time after closing the game.
[*] New particle effects have been added for the character unlock screen.
[*] The last used Settings tab is now remembered.
[*] Shiori's age has been corrected.
[*] The accent colour of a character (i.e. the border around their icon) now determines the background colour of the refill quote.
[*] Updated the final campaign character's accent colour to be more in line with his colour scheme.
[*] Balance: Updated some of the newer stages.
[*] Fix: Refill quotes for the final campaign character are now unique.
[*] Fix: A rare crash that can happen if you pull too quickly on the Gumball Machine.
[/list]
The new characters have been tested on Legend difficulty to make sure they are reasonably doable with the new timers.

notes.title: 1.11.3: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The ninth character has an updated preview icon (the previous artwork was very rough!!)
[*] Balance: Rika's alternate stage accidentally got very easy after the last update. Ice no longer combines according to Suika rules on this stage (this was a very confusing behaviour).
[*] Fix: The Sweet Viewer now always shows the sweet ID, to assist with custom stage creation.
[*] Fix: Custom characters should no longer crash the game if side art textures are missing.
[/list]
[h3]The Kemopop! OST![/h3]
The Kemopop! OST is now available on Steam. The soundtrack is a rearrangement of the beats in the game, plus a bonus track. Enable high-quality soundtrack downloads to access the FLAC-encoded master.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136200/Kemopop_Soundtrack]Check out the Kemopop! Soundtrack!!!![/url] There is a 15% discount until the 8th of October.

notes.title: 1.10.1: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everynyan!!

[*] Fix a crash when viewing a character biography via a language fallback.
[*] Two sweets have had their colours harmonised a little better for improved readability.

That is all, sorry. The crash just irked me...

Two new campaign stages [i]and[/i] one new guest character stage are on the way later this month!!!

notes.title: 1.9.4: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello again,

This small update fixes an issue I forgot to post in the previous patch notes, since an interface was updated for a better load transition: The "New Hire" screen will no longer show placeholder text when loading in the character. This was only really a problem on slower machines, but I hate leaving bugs in.

Sorry!! Thank you!!!

notes.title: 1.9.3: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello!! Some cleanup work was done as we prepare for a release of a Demo version that'll be published to the Steam store, hopefully sometime later next week.

[list]
[*] The tooltips on the left-hand side buttons have an improved appearance and can now be activated using only a keyboard or controller.
[*] You can no longer change the difficulty setting during a game (this was unintended and breaks a lot of things).
[*] The drop rate of Rainbow sweets on Lambun's and Sencha's second stage has been greatly reduced to that of a normal sweet, to stop the game going on forever!!!
[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.5: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
I am travelling the USA right now, so I haven't had much time to sit down. But, I wanted to do some quick updates this week @w@

[list]
[*] Clicking the right stick on a controller will now skip to the next track (this has been undocumented as N on the keyboard; now you know!!).
[*] Several sweet sprites have been updated to provide improved visual contrast, to prevent confusion with similar-looking sweets.
[*] Two new sweet types are available in the Gumball Machine.
[*] A new music track is available in the Gumball Machine.
[*] Some artwork on the gumball machine has been updated.
[*] Brock now has a new preference for pastries, so they'll appear on his stage more often after they have been unlocked. 
[*] Some optimisations across the board!!
[/list]
